_comment: Optional: copy to <project>/.claude/stock-band.json. Every key has a default, so a partial file is fine.
_marketSwitcher_comment: Which of four styles the band uses to switch market/holdings: "menu" (default) draws a header Button that opens a column of plain option Buttons below it - every option takes a mouse click, unlike "select"'s dropdown; "select" draws the engine's own dropdown (falls back to "cycle" on a surface with no Select at all, e.g. mobile) - its options only take the keyboard (arrows + Enter) while it holds focus, no click; "tabs" draws all five stops (台股/台股庫存/美股/美股庫存/加密貨幣) as their own Buttons, one press each, and drops to "cycle" if the terminal is too narrow to fit them; "cycle" draws one Button that walks all five stops in order. An unrecognized value falls back to "menu".
_twSources_comment: Where Taiwan prices come from, in preference order - the band tries the first entry and falls through to the next when it has nothing fresh this tick. "yahoo" needs no setup, ~20 min behind. "shioaji" is 永豐's real-time feed (macOS/Linux) and "capital" is 群益's (Windows); the band spawns scripts/fetch-quotes-shioaji.py / scripts/fetch-quotes-capital.py itself (see the `shioaji` and `capital` blocks below and references/quote-sources.md). This project file's default is ["yahoo"] alone - a source order and broker paths are a PERSONAL preference, not a project one, so put your own in ~/.claude/stock-band.json instead of here (it merges under this file: built-in defaults < ~/.claude/stock-band.json < this file). A legacy "twSource": "x" (a single string) still works as an alias for ["x"].
_shioaji_comment: Read only when "shioaji" is somewhere in twSources - normally that means it belongs in ~/.claude/stock-band.json, not here. `env` holds SINOBON_API_KEY/SINOBON_SECRET_KEY (never commit it); `~` expands to $HOME.
_capital_comment: Read only when "capital" is somewhere in twSources - same story as shioaji, and normally belongs in ~/.claude/stock-band.json too. Windows only (SKCOM is a COM DLL). `env` holds CAPITAL_USER_ID/CAPITAL_PASSWORD (never commit it); `dll` is the registered SKCOM.dll and has NO default, because 群益 ships a zip with no install location; `indices` are SKCOM 商品代號 for the footer board, probed at startup and dropped if they do not resolve ([] turns the board off). See references/quote-sources.md §4.
_holdings_comment: The 損益 view's manual alternative to stock-holdings.json (which wins for whichever market it names). qty is shares, not 張; cost is the average cost per share.
_holdingsSource_comment: "file" (default): the holdings file the broker script writes wins. "config": the holdings block above wins - use it to show a demo portfolio while the Taiwan route is a live brokerage.
_tw_comment: Taiwan 上櫃 symbols need "ex": "otc"; 上市 is the default. prevClose only matters for demo prices.
